headline: Congress named a Postal Service building in Arlington, Texas, after former Representative Ron Wright.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 3903 Melear Drive in Arlington, Texas, as the Ron Wright Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff. It is an honorary designation.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 20, 2022, and the designation took effect on that date.
